_info: Blog metadata is sourced from frontmatter in content/blogs/*.md files. Drop a new .md file in that folder to publish a new post automatically.

frontmatterSchema.title: string — post title shown in listing and article header
frontmatterSchema.description: string — short summary shown on blog listing cards (100–160 chars recommended)

example.title: My New Blog Post
example.description: A short description of what this post covers and why it matters.
